verdict.rationale: Portkey's REST API is versioned: its documented base URL is `https://api.portkey.ai/v1`. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, version lifecycle or sunset timelines, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, versioning/changelog guarantees, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The base URL for all REST API requests is `https://api.portkey.ai/v1`
